title: P007 monolithic construction and removable P003↔P007 J2 process baseline
problem: Legacy weld-process/MBOM records coexist with the selected removable C2R1 service boundary.

decision.P007_construction: Monolithic machined AISI 316L / EN 1.4404 body with integral blind end.
decision.P003_P007_joint: Removable metal mating faces + static axial O-ring + 3×M2.5 clamp screws; locator pilot provides radial location.
decision.permanent_P003_P007_weld: REJECTED / NOT APPLICABLE to active C2R1.
decision.drawing_consequence: K01-D-006 shall not carry a P003↔P007 weld symbol. P007 detail drawing defines one monolithic manufactured part.
decision.bom_consequence: Retire NM-P007-WELD-PROCESS and legacy MBOM-P007-WELDED-CONSTRUCTION from active MBOM; preserve as superseded history.

basis: DOS-J2-C2R1-v2 rejects permanent P003↔P007 weld because it destroys required service access.
CI-J2 C2R1 technical filter states serviceability PASS_WITH_LIMIT with No weld.
C2R1 P007 manufacturing route is deep-bore/finish thin can with integral blind end and OD33×3 flange.
Existing J2 process definition already required applicability review and prohibited silent carry-over of legacy welding.

rejected_alternatives.reason: No controlled need/subcomponent identities; monolithic route selected.

release_boundary: Closes architecture/process applicability only; does not close seal/leak qualification, fastener process, thin-wall process capability or product release.
